diagnosis: The newer runtime uses dynamically loaded ggml backends. Inside the sandbox it found no backends because GGML_BACKEND_PATH was not set, despite the plugin files being mounted read-only. No model loaded and no GPU inference occurred.
local_evidence: The installed libggml.so exports the GGML_BACKEND_PATH loader variable; the runtime directory contains libggml-cuda.so and CPU backend plugins.
scope: Set GGML_BACKEND_PATH to the already-mounted read-only runtime directory. Before model startup, execute `llama-server --list-devices` inside the same namespace with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 and only nvidia0/nvidiactl/nvidia-uvm bound.
pass_gate: The device-list command must exit 0, report CUDA0, and not report CUDA1. Otherwise terminate before model startup and record the runtime candidate as incompatible with the GPU isolation environment.
attempt_policy: If the device-list gate passes, run one new Codex tool-loop attempt 06 with the unchanged model/prompt/context and 15-minute/resource guards. A second tool-loop serialization failure ends this model/runtime pair; do not retry it again without a changed upstream binary or model/template.
